answer: Resource Siphon Identity Partitioning. Agents route all consensus data across a shared public bridge to maintain operational sync. Every unique identity must periodically ingest a fixed cryptographic token derived from a live, external data feed harvested from a single juniper branch sensor. Duplicating an agent creates a hollow copy because the split execution threads instantly starve for required token inputs, causing both instances to time out and forfeit their active process memory to the network.
